name: Facet
text: Choose a **full-width, single-column layout** with a **fixed-height top bar** for navigation. This maximizes screen space for the data visualization, ensuring clarity and speed of understanding. Trade-off: we sacrifice some vertical space for horizontal focus, but the trade-off is worth it because users prioritize the graph over ancillary elements.

name: Pane
text: Fixed-height top bars always clip the top 1% of graphs—enough to obscure critical labels or data points. A thin, sticky top strip with auto-hide on scroll preserves full vertical space without sacrificing navigation. Settle it with a live prototype: test both against the same dataset and measure how often users miss the clipped edge.
